name: Logto

evidence.hosted: F02: Logto Cloud hosted identity platform; F05: vendor hosts and manages Cloud
evidence.server: F02: free self-hosted open-source server; F05: developer runs server and PostgreSQL

line: Open-source login service with a managed Cloud option.

free.text: Cloud Free: 50,000 MAU and 50,000 access tokens

mau.math: At 2,000 assumed access tokens (passes that prove a sign-in), Free covers 1,000 users. Users alone cannot set the real token bill.
At 20,000 assumed access tokens (passes that prove a sign-in), Free covers 10,000 users. Users alone cannot set the real token bill.
With 2 sign-ins per user, that is 100,000 access tokens. Pro is $24, plus $0.08 for each 100 tokens over the included amount, which is 100,000 minus 50,000. That comes to $64 a month.
With 2 sign-ins per user, that is 200,000 access tokens. Pro is $24, plus $0.08 for each 100 tokens over the included amount, which is 200,000 minus 50,000. That comes to $144 a month.
